name: Xtile By Xenlism
description: 1x1 app launcher tile: centered icon, app name at the bottom, and a card background auto-tinted from the app's own icon color. Type an app's name (e.g. "firefox", "gimp") in settings - no file browsing needed. Add this widget as many times as you like, one per app.
author: Nattapong Pullkhow
